name: app-fintech-case-study-quote-and-project-info
title: Grey-blue quote slide with project metadata
whatItIs: A pale grey slide with a soft blue gradient. A large quote mark and two-tone statement (black then grey) sits above an avatar and name; at the bottom, Project and About columns list metadata in slash-separated labels.
whatItMeans: Quiet, professional and elegant; the layout gives the words all the weight.
techniques: Set a statement half in black, half in grey to build hierarchy in one paragraph.
Use slash-separated label/value pairs for compact metadata.
Place a small avatar and name beneath a quote for credibility.
Keep background a soft misty gradient with no other decoration.

vocabulary.definition: One statement in two tones for emphasis.
Metadata shown as grey label and dark value.
A very soft pale gradient background.
